lines.maoEnglish:
“Then, Miss Akiha. We must tell Hisui about this too.”
“Yes. But we need not involve Hisui. My brother can barely move. You and I will be more than enough to finish him.”
――――Hah, hah, hah.

“Listen carefully, Kohaku. Do not let my brother suspect anything. I intend to settle this within the next few days, and I want him to suffer as little as possible.”
“Yes, I understand. In any case, since he cannot rise from bed unaided, there is little danger he will notice.”

lines.japanese:

だから、あと一日だけ我慢していてください」
　バタン、と閉じられる扉。

lines.maoEnglish:

I can barely breathe. Akiha is right: if this continues, I really will waste away and die.
“Hah, hah, hah.”
